text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
CONTAINERS - Fair Cosmos - (built 1980) 5,983 dwt sold to Malaysian buyers for $1.5 million.
RORO - Truskavets - (built 1986) 17,850 dwt sold to North American buyers for $7.37 million.
SOLD FOR DEMOLITION - (built 1975) 392,966 dwt sold to Bangladeshi buyers for $172 per ldt "as is".
Mary D - (built 1975) 48,716 dwt sold for $187 per ldt to undisclosed buyers.
Seafox - (built 1970) 21,939 dwt sold for $195 per ldt to undisclosed buyers.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to inspection, survey or other conditions.
